APPROVE. The extraction keeps the original control flow (each former `continue` becomes `return null`, which the caller skips), the nullable-tuple `is not var (...)` guard compiles and definitely assigns its variables, and moving the chain/guard logic into the two helpers should bring the method well under 15.

I judged this from the diff alone, since I didn't build it. The one thing I couldn't check is whether `verb` is still used in the caller after this change, because that would matter under warnings-as-errors.
